test_inputs.explanation: The agent visited the admin Online Customers URL (base_url). The long /index/filter/... segment is a base64-like encoded filter string which decodes to parameters: customer_id[from]=100 and customer_id[to]=200, firstname=Alice, lastname=Smith, email=alice.smith@example.com, session_start_time and last_activity locales set to en_US, type=c and last_url=/checkout/cart. 'type=c' was mapped to the tool-friendly value 'Customer'. Empty fields were left blank because no concrete values for them were present in the encoded URL.
